notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
If the sacrificed creature was an Elemental, Omnath triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Zimone and Dina ability, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Omnath trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Omnath trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.
